name: UTM Link Builder
description: Build a campaign-tracking URL with UTM source, medium, campaign, term, and content parameters correctly appended and encoded.

faq.question: What happens if my URL already has query parameters?
faq.answer: They're preserved — UTM parameters are merged in alongside any existing ones (like ?ref=123) rather than replacing the whole query string.

faq.question: Which parameters are actually required?
faq.answer: utm_source, utm_medium, and utm_campaign are the minimum Google Analytics and most other analytics platforms need to attribute traffic to a campaign. utm_term (for tracking paid search keywords) and utm_content (for distinguishing multiple links within the same campaign, e.g. an A/B test) are optional extras.
